The dish is a metal bowl, probably about 25–30 cm across since it fills much of the frame. The food is two small rectangular pizza pieces, each about 5 cm by 8 cm, topped with cheese and a little pepperoni.

Each piece is thin, probably about 1.5 cm thick, and looks like cafeteria rectangle pizza. A piece of that size likely weighs 50–60 g, so the two together are about 110 g.

Pizza runs about 270 kcal per 100 g, so 110 g comes to roughly 300 kcal. The pieces look small and possibly partly eaten, so I'll settle slightly lower, at about 100 g and 270 kcal.
